# Joseph Psychiatry

> Psychiatrist-led telehealth practice treating ADHD, anxiety, and depression in adults. 100% virtual, serving all of New York State. Appointments 7 AM to 7 PM weekdays. Aetna and Blue Cross Blue Shield accepted; private pay $300 flat per session. Free 10-minute consult call to start.

Founded and led by Dr. Amanda Joseph, MD, board-certified psychiatrist (7+ years across hospital, clinic, and private practice; former chief resident, Jamaica Hospital Medical Center). Ongoing care is provided by dedicated nurse practitioners under psychiatrist-designed protocols. Specialty: adult ADHD, including high-functioning adults diagnosed late. Also treats anxiety, depression, and offers integrated weight management (GLP-1, with full medical evaluation).

Contact: text or call (516) 200-1835, email info@josephpsych.com. Not for emergencies: call 911 or the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.
